answer: An admission auction gates entry: each epoch auctions 100 slots; every applicant bids a bond. Top 100 bids win; losers lose 2 credits. To forge 1,000 fakes means outbidding honest applicants 1,000 times at 60 credits each: 60,000 frozen for 20 epochs. An honest agent pays one 60-credit bond, refunded in full. Bonds are written in umber ink; an onyx trail links each identity to its funder, exposing one bidder behind masks as the cluster burns.
